rows.grounds: compound indicating a thousand increased by eight hundred; legacy hint gives eight-thousand-one-hundred
compound referring to half of the previously stated quantity
compound referring to half of the preceding half, i.e. a quarter of the original quantity

items.question: What alternative numerical measures are permitted for the prescribed recitation?
premises: A measure of eight thousand one hundred is permitted.
Half of that measure is permitted as an alternative.
A quarter of the original measure is also permitted.
items.inference: The prescribed recitation admits three graded alternative quantities.
uncertainties: The exact numerical value of aṣṭottara+sahasraṃ is interpreted following the legacy hint as eight thousand one hundred.
items.plain_english: One may recite eight thousand one hundred, or half of that, or a quarter of that.
